name: Discard Block
description: Discard 2 [[card]]s (except [[finisher]]s) to block an attack, then gain the initiative.

name: Stamina Block
description: Spend -2 [[stamina]] to block a 3rd consecutive attack of -1 or -2 damage, then gain the initiative.

name: Reversal
description: Spend -2 [[stamina]] to gain the initiative, deal -2 [[health]] to opponent, and gain +2 [[momentum]].

name: Recover
description: Gain +2 [[stamina]] and draw 1 [[card]]. Opponent also gains +1 [[stamina]], +1 [[health]], and draws 1 [[card]].

name: Taunt
description: Gain +1 [[stamina]], +1 [[momentum]], and draw 2 [[card]]s. Opponent also gains +1 [[stamina]], +1 [[health]], and draws 1 [[card]].
effectScript: wrestler.stamina += 1; wrestler.momentum += 1; wrestler.drawCard(2); opponent.stamina += 1; opponent.health += 1; opponent.drawCard(1)
